bracu_official.title: BRAC University Biotechnology students gain industry exposure through BRAC-Aarong Dairy Visit
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University Biotechnology students visited BRAC-Aarong Dairy, providing them with valuable hands-on industry exposure. This visit is part of their academic and practical learning experience.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University holds workshop on BAC Accreditation readiness
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University recently hosted a workshop designed to prepare for BAC Accreditation. The event focused on ensuring the university meets the required standards for accreditation.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University announces advisory council and fellows for new Centre of Energy and Logistics (CEL)
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University proudly announced the advisory council and fellows for its newly established Centre of Energy and Logistics (CEL). This marks a significant step in the center's development and future initiatives.

bracu_official.title: Admission Test Results Notice, Fall 2026
bracu_official.summary: A notice has been released regarding the admission test results for the Fall 2026 semester. Applicants are advised to check the official announcement for details.

bracu_official.title: 18th Convocation 2026 Announcement
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University has made an official announcement for its 18th Convocation, scheduled to take place in 2026. Further details about the event are expected to follow.

bracu_official.title: Mid-Term Exam schedule, Summer 2026
bracu_official.summary: The schedule for the mid-term examinations for the Summer 2026 semester has been published. Students are encouraged to review the schedule carefully for their respective courses.
